what: The declared FLOOR for Bun FRONT overlays. Human pin. Same posture as runtimes/rails-base/FLOOR.json.
why: ADR 0072: FRONT is a Bun container with its own image. Overlays FROM that digest.
A mutable :latest is not a pin. check_base_digests already refuses undigested FROM lines.
Do not auto-bump. publish-images rebuilding front-base does not move this file.

floor.note: LOCAL working floor, not a GHCR index. Built 2026-09-17 on linux/arm64 from runtimes/front-base/Dockerfile WITH THE REPO ROOT AS BUILD CONTEXT -- the Dockerfile COPYs from gems/, so runtimes/front-base is not a valid context and building there fails on every COPY. bun 1.4.2-slim@sha256:cb3bbbb08e. docker inspect Id=sha256:fcb9d0021cdfec2697cf8a8006c423106c80ebd76810b37eba33bd6bb595d6c6 Architecture=arm64 Os=linux. That Id is an OCI image INDEX (mediaType application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, size 856): BuildKit exports a platform manifest (sha256:9e6f176e61e8ac28173c0f8849b02443d0d791bc51c50ab5b81c409d6db34ac7) plus an attestation manifest under one index, so index_digest carries the digest here rather than false -- vv-dependency-orch treats index_digest == digest when an index exists and false only for a lone manifest. Rebuilt because c44c62e added the overlay-hooks loader to src/server.js; the previous pin sha256:6691de3d described source without it, and that image no longer exists locally (the -t retag dropped its last reference), so it was not available as a control. FROM front-base@sha256:<id> does NOT resolve for a local never-pushed image -- verified, exit 1 -- so overlays must use the tag front-base:local. Last public GHCR index does not exist until publish-images ships front-base. Do not invent a registry digest. Do not auto-bump.

bun_base.note: Multi-arch index digest for the Bun runtime the FRONT Dockerfile FROMs. Not the front-base FLOOR.

moving_the_floor: Edit this file. That is the whole mechanism.
Every consumer's gate compares its FRONT pin to this file and fails on a mismatch.
Bump the consumers promptly, or revert here.
